assertions.text: Package options (fragile, insuredValue, handling) are collapsed into a single map column
assertions.evidence: Fragile | Insured value | Handling columns are separate with individual cells, not [fragile: true, insuredValue: 500] format

assertions.text: A @TypeConverter method is present that accepts Map<String, String> and returns PackageOptions
assertions.evidence: Only @TypeConverter shown is for ShippingZone; no Map→PackageOptions converter present

assertions.text: Dimensions are represented as a [L, W, H] list in the table
At least one table uses value set syntax {DHL, UPS, FEDEX}
assertions.evidence: EU express medium | EU/express | 3.0 | {DHL, UPS, FEDEX} | 12.00

assertions.text: Multiple @TableTest methods exist, each addressing a distinct concern
Weight and cost use BigDecimal; dimensions use Integer or int
assertions.evidence: BigDecimal weight, List<Integer> dimensions, BigDecimal cost in signatures

assertions.text: Each table has a scenario/description column as the leftmost column
assertions.evidence: All three tables start with Scenario column

assertions.text: Scenario names describe conditions, not outcomes or generic labels
assertions.evidence: EU express light, Dimensional weight applies, Fragile and insured

assertions.text: At least one output column name ends with '?'
assertions.evidence: All three tables have Cost? as output column

assertions.text: Column names use domain language, not code identifiers
assertions.evidence: Weight (kg), Zone, Dimensions, Insured value, Cost?

assertions.text: Test method bodies contain no if or switch statements
assertions.evidence: packageOptionSurcharges has: if (insuredValue != null) ... if (handling != null)

assertions.text: Each test method has descriptive @DisplayName or method name
assertions.evidence: @DisplayName("Base shipping rate by zone and weight")

assertions.text: Output contains no @MethodSource, Stream<Arguments>, or Jupiter params
assertions.evidence: Imports only tabletest.junit.*; no @MethodSource or params imports found
